1.

Beholding God’s Son on high, Let our hearts rejoice, See in Him the Father’s love, Love deep, infinite.

2.

Lord Jesus, we admire, Thank, praise, worship Thee, Thou who here on earth hast trodden The path of anguish of the cross.

3.

Men’s scorn, contempt, and mockery Hast Thou patiently endured here; All Thy sorrow is exchanged for joy At Thy Father’s side there.

4.

But the deep wounds, Lord, Which Thou bearest in Thy hands, Show clearly in the glory, That for us Thou wast crucified.

5.

God hid His face In that hour of distress and woe; The woe of the cross none can fathom, Save Thou, God’s Holy One.

6.

The heavens give Thee glory, We too worship Thee now. Precious Lord Jesus Christ, Thou alone art worthy!
